text: {"rules":[{"id":"SYPH-SCREEN-PREG","version":"May 2025","title":"Syphilis screening during pregnancy (asymptomatic pregnant women)","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends early, universal screening for syphilis infection during pregnancy; if an individual is not screened early in pregnancy, the USPSTF recommends screening at the first available opportunity.","grade":"A","effective_date":"May 2025","action":"Screen for syphilis infection during pregnancy, early in pregnancy or at the first available opportunity if not screened early","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"pregnancy\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"during pregnancy\", \"note\": \"Pregnancy active during the measurement year; the engine cannot confirm the pregnancy episode overlaps the year\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"absence of signs or symptoms of syphilis (clinical assessment)\"}, \"quote\": \"asymptomatic\"}], \"quote\": \"asymptomatic pregnant women\"}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"syphilis_test\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"screening for syphilis infection during pregnancy\", \"note\": \"Guideline requires the test within the pregnancy episode; the measurement-year window only approximates the pregnancy period and cannot check that it was early in pregnancy\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The pregnancy-relative timing ('early' in pregnancy, otherwise 'at the first available opportunity') cannot be expressed with measurement-year windows; the numerator window is the measurement year and pregnancies spanning two calendar years may be misclassified. Human review should confirm or replace with a pregnancy-episode window.","Asymptomatic status is not reliably held in structured EHR data and is encoded as uncomputable in the denominator.","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('May 2025 *') whose footnote is not included in the section text and is not represented.","Repeat screening later in pregnancy or at delivery for higher-risk individuals is not stated in this section and is not represented."]}
